mechanism_narrative: Increasing GDP indicates strong economic activity, leading to higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns do not show a positive correlation with GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment leads to economic slowdown, negatively impacting S&P 500 returns within 5 days.
failure_condition: No negative impact on returns when unemployment rises.

mechanism_narrative: Low federal funds rate and high unemployment stimulate economic growth, boosting S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: No positive correlation between the proxies and returns.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth signals economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: Returns do not increase with industrial production growth.

mechanism_narrative: Lower federal funds rate increases borrowing, stimulating investments and positive S&P 500 returns within 5 days.
failure_condition: No positive impact on returns with lower rates.

mechanism_narrative: Decreased retail sales indicate weaker demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Returns do not decrease with falling retail sales.

mechanism_narrative: Employment growth with low interest rates boosts consumer spending, increasing S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: No positive correlation between employment and returns.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts indicate economic recovery, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Returns do not increase with higher housing starts.
